<section class="jr-sec jr-chapters" id="chapters" aria-labelledby="h-jr-chapters">
  <div class="jr-head"><h2 id="h-jr-chapters">Chapters</h2><p>One page for each place I have lived: what the chapter was, its footprints and its stamps.</p></div>
  <noscript><style>.jr-pg-map { display: none; }</style></noscript>
  <div class="jr-pages-wrap">
    <ol class="jr-pages" id="jr-pages" tabindex="0" aria-label="Chapters, one page each">
      <li class="jr-page" id="ch-baotou" style="--ch: var(--ch-baotou)" aria-labelledby="h-ch-baotou">
        <header class="jr-pg-head">
          <p class="jr-pg-no">Chapter 1 · Sep 2010 – Jul 2014</p>
          <h3 id="h-ch-baotou">Baotou</h3>
          <p class="jr-pg-where">Inner Mongolia, China</p>
        </header>
        <p class="jr-pg-text">Four years at university, farther from home than I had ever been: the northern edge of the country, and the first journeys of my own.</p>
        <div class="jr-pg-map" data-ch="baotou">
          <div class="jr-zm" tabindex="0" role="group" aria-label="Map of the chapter Baotou. Plus and minus zoom, the arrow keys pan, Escape leaves the map."></div>
        </div>
        <ul class="jr-pg-nums">
          <li><strong>32</strong> new places</li>
          <li><strong>13,800</strong> km, roughly</li>
          <li><strong>4</strong> firsts</li>
        </ul>
        <ul class="jr-pg-stamps" aria-label="Stamps of this chapter">
          <li class="jr-pstamp is-first" style="--rot: 2.5deg"><i class="bi bi-star-fill" aria-hidden="true"></i><span class="jr-ps-main">First time away from home</span><span class="jr-ps-sub">Baotou · Sep 2010</span></li>
          <li class="jr-pstamp is-first" style="--rot: -1.5deg"><i class="bi bi-star-fill" aria-hidden="true"></i><span class="jr-ps-main">First trip of my own</span><span class="jr-ps-sub">Yinchuan · May 2011</span></li>
          <li class="jr-pstamp is-first" style="--rot: 3.5deg"><i class="bi bi-star-fill" aria-hidden="true"></i><span class="jr-ps-main">First of the Five Great Mountains</span><span class="jr-ps-sub">Mount Heng · 2,016 m · May 2012</span></li>
